% A test for tex8web: colors in dark mode. \textcolor, \colorbox's and
% \fcolorbox's, listings' and those in math each get another lightness in
% dark mode (a light-dark() of the color); black text is the page's text
% color. Colors in math and table cells as the PDF has them: a document's
% own, an xcolor mix and complement, xcolor's names that CSS gives other
% values and those its options define, and the models MathJax lacks; and
% colortbl's \rowcolor and \cellcolor.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[dvipsnames,svgnames,x11names]{xcolor}
\usepackage{listings}
\usepackage{colortbl}
\definecolor{navy}{RGB}{0,0,128}
\definecolor{ink}{RGB}{200,0,100}
\colorlet{ember}{ink!50!black}
\newcommand{\warm}[1]{\textcolor{red!50!yellow}{#1}}
\begin{document}
Plain, \textcolor{navy}{navy}, \textcolor{black}{black},
\colorbox{yellow!30}{on yellow} and \fcolorbox{blue}{green!10}{framed}.
In math, $a + \textcolor{red}{b} + {\color{black} c}$ and
\[ \colorbox{yellow}{$x$} + \fcolorbox{blue}{white}{$y$} + \rule{1em}{1pt}. \]
In math, $\textcolor{ink}{a} + \textcolor{red!50!black}{b} + \textcolor{green}{c} + \textcolor{ember}{d} + \warm{e}$.
Mixes and complements as xcolor rounds and takes them:
$\textcolor{gray!50}{a} + \textcolor{ink!50!yellow!50}{b} + \textcolor{-ink}{c} + \textcolor{-red!50!black}{d}$.
Names of the options: $\textcolor{Apricot}{e} + \textcolor{Blue!50}{f} + \textcolor{Azure3}{g}$.
Models: $\textcolor[HTML]{3366CC}{h} + \textcolor[cmyk]{0.2,0.5,0.1,0.3}{i} + \textcolor[Gray]{8}{j}$.

\begin{tabular}{ll}
\rowcolor{yellow!30} one & two \\
\cellcolor{ink!25} three & four \\
\rowcolor{-ink} five & \cellcolor{-ink} six \\
\end{tabular}

\begin{document}
\end{lstlisting}
\end{document}
